1.english_reference: So the king and Haman came

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹ֤א הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְ הָמָ֔ן
traditions.LXX: Εἰσῆλθεν δὲ ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ Ἁμὰν
traditions.VUL: Intrávit ítaque rex et Aman ,
traditions.KJV: So the king and Haman came

1.english_reference: to banquet with Esther the queen

traditions.WLC: לִ שְׁתּ֖וֹת עִם אֶסְתֵּ֥ר הַ מַּלְכָּֽה
traditions.LXX: συνπιεῖν τῇ βασιλίσσῃ .
traditions.VUL: ut bíberent cum regína .
traditions.KJV: to banquet with Esther the queen .

2.english_reference: And the king said again unto Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּאמֶר֩ הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ לְ אֶסְתֵּ֜ר גַּ֣ם בַּ יּ֤וֹם הַ שֵּׁנִי֙ בְּ מִשְׁתֵּ֣ה הַ יַּ֔יִן
traditions.LXX: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἐσθὴρ τῇ δευτέρᾳ ἡμέρᾳ ἐν τῷ πότῳ
traditions.VUL: Dixítque ei rex étiam secúnda die , postquam vino incalúerat :
traditions.KJV: And the king said again unto Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine ,

2.english_reference: What [ is ] thy petition , queen Esther ?

traditions.WLC: מַה שְּׁאֵלָתֵ֛ ךְ אֶסְתֵּ֥ר הַ מַּלְכָּ֖ה
traditions.LXX: Τί ἐστιν , Ἐσθὴρ βασίλισσα ,
traditions.VUL: Quæ est petítio tua Esther ,
traditions.KJV: What [ is ] thy petition , queen Esther ?

2.english_reference: and it shall be granted thee :

traditions.WLC: וְ תִנָּ֣תֵֽן לָ֑ ךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τί τὸ αἴτημά σου
traditions.VUL: ut detur tibi ?
traditions.KJV: and it shall be granted thee :

traditions.WLC: וּ מַה בַּקָּשָׁתֵ֛ ךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τί τὸ ἀξίωμά σου ;
traditions.VUL: et quid vis fíeri ?
traditions.KJV: and what [ is ] thy request ?

2.english_reference: and it shall be performed , [ even ] to the half of the kingdom .

traditions.WLC: עַד חֲצִ֥י הַ מַּלְכ֖וּת וְ תֵעָֽשׂ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔστω σοι ἕως τοῦ ἡμίσους τῆς βασιλείας μου .
traditions.VUL: étiam si dimídiam partem regni mei petíeris , impetrábis .
traditions.KJV: and it shall be performed , [ even ] to the half of the kingdom .

3.english_reference: Then Esther the queen answered and said

traditions.WLC: וַ תַּ֨עַן אֶסְתֵּ֤ר הַ מַּלְכָּה֙ וַ תֹּאמַ֔ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀποκριθεῖσα εἶπεν
traditions.VUL: Ad quem illa respóndit :
traditions.KJV: Then Esther the queen answered and said ,

3.english_reference: If I have found favour in thy sight , O king

traditions.WLC: אִם מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֤ן בְּ עֵינֶ֨י ךָ֙ הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: Εἰ εὗρον χάριν ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως ,
traditions.VUL: Si invéni grátiam in óculis tuis o rex ,
traditions.KJV: If I have found favour in thy sight , O king ,

3.english_reference: and if it please the king

traditions.WLC: וְ אִם עַל הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ ט֑וֹב
traditions.VUL: et si tibi placet ,
traditions.KJV: and if it please the king ,

3.english_reference: let my life be given me at my petition

traditions.WLC: תִּנָּֽתֶן לִ֤ י נַפְשִׁ י֙ בִּ שְׁאֵ֣לָתִ֔ י
traditions.LXX: δοθήτω ἡ ψυχὴ τῷ αἰτήματί μου ,
traditions.VUL: dona mihi ánimam meam pro qua rogo ,
traditions.KJV: let my life be given me at my petition ,

3.english_reference: and my people at my request

traditions.WLC: וְ עַמִּ֖ י בְּ בַקָּשָׁתִֽ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὁ λόγος μου τῷ ἀξιώματί μου .
traditions.VUL: et pópulum meum pro quo óbsecro .
traditions.KJV: and my people at my request :

4.english_reference: For we are sold , I and my people

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י נִמְכַּ֨רְנוּ֙ אֲנִ֣י וְ עַמִּ֔ י
traditions.LXX: ἐπράθημεν γὰρ ἐγώ τε καὶ ὁ λαός μου
traditions.VUL: Tráditi enim sumus ego et pópulus meus ,
traditions.KJV: For we are sold , I and my people ,

4.english_reference: to be destroyed , to be slain , and to perish

traditions.WLC: לְ הַשְׁמִ֖יד לַ הֲר֣וֹג וּ לְ אַבֵּ֑ד
traditions.LXX: εἰς ἀπωλίαν καὶ διαρπαγὴν καὶ δουλίαν ,
traditions.VUL: ut conterámur , iugulémur , et pereámus .
traditions.KJV: to be destroyed , to be slain , and to perish .

4.english_reference: But if we had been sold for bondmen and bondwomen

traditions.WLC: וְ֠ אִלּוּ לַ עֲבָדִ֨ים וְ לִ שְׁפָח֤וֹת נִמְכַּ֨רְנוּ֙
traditions.LXX: ἡμεῖς καὶ τὰ τέκνα ἡμῶν εἰς παῖδας καὶ παιδίσκας ,
traditions.VUL: Atque útinam in servos et fámulas venderémur :
traditions.KJV: But if we had been sold for bondmen and bondwomen ,

traditions.WLC: הֶחֱרַ֔שְׁתִּי
traditions.LXX: καὶ παρήκουσα ·
traditions.VUL: esset tolerábile malum , et gemens tacérem :
traditions.KJV: I had held my tongue ,

4.english_reference: although the enemy could not countervail the king ’s damage

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין הַ צָּ֛ר שֹׁוֶ֖ה בְּ נֵ֥זֶק הַ מֶּֽלֶךְ
traditions.LXX: οὐ γὰρ ἄξιος ὁ διάβολος τῆς αὐλῆς τοῦ βασιλέως .
traditions.VUL: nunc autem hostis noster est , cuius crudélitas redúndat in regem .
traditions.KJV: although the enemy could not countervail the king ’s damage .

5.english_reference: Then the king Ahasuerus answered and said unto Esther the queen

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הַ מֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲחַשְׁוֵר֔וֹשׁ וַ יֹּ֖אמֶר לְ אֶסְתֵּ֣ר הַ מַּלְכָּ֑ה
traditions.LXX: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ βασιλεύς
traditions.VUL: Respondénsque rex Assuérus ait :
traditions.KJV: Then the king Ahasuerus answered and said unto Esther the queen ,

5.english_reference: Who is he , and where is he

traditions.WLC: מִ֣י ה֥וּא זֶה֙ וְ אֵֽי זֶ֣ה ה֔וּא
traditions.LXX: Τίς οὗτος
traditions.VUL: Quis est iste , et cuius poténtiæ ,
traditions.KJV: Who is he , and where is he ,

5.english_reference: that durst presume in his heart to do so ?

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁר מְלָא֥ וֹ לִבּ֖ וֹ לַ עֲשׂ֥וֹת כֵּֽן
traditions.LXX: ὅστις ἐτόλμησεν ποιῆσαι τὸ πρᾶγμα τοῦτο ;
traditions.VUL: ut hæc áudeat fácere ?
traditions.KJV: that durst presume in his heart to do so ?

traditions.WLC: וַ תֹּ֣אמֶר אֶסְתֵּ֔ר
traditions.LXX: εἶπεν δὲ Ἐσθήρ
traditions.VUL: Dixítque Esther :
traditions.KJV: And Esther said ,

6.english_reference: The adversary and enemy [ is ] this wicked Haman

traditions.WLC: אִ֚ישׁ צַ֣ר וְ אוֹיֵ֔ב הָמָ֥ן הָ רָ֖ע הַ זֶּ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Ἄνθρωπος ἐχθρὸς Ἁμὰν ὁ πονηρὸς οὗτος .
traditions.VUL: Hostis et inimícus noster péssimus iste est Aman .
traditions.KJV: The adversary and enemy [ is ] this wicked Haman .

6.english_reference: Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen

traditions.WLC: וְ הָמָ֣ן נִבְעַ֔ת מִ לִּ פְנֵ֥י הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ וְ הַ מַּלְכָּֽה
traditions.LXX: Ἁμὰν δὲ ἐταράχθη ἀπὸ τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ τῆς βασιλίσσης .
traditions.VUL: Quod ille áudiens , íllico obstúpuit , vultum regis ac regínæ ferre non sústinens .
traditions.KJV: Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen .

7.english_reference: And the king arising from the banquet of wine in his wrath [ went ] into the palace garden

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ מֶּ֜לֶךְ קָ֤ם בַּ חֲמָת וֹ֙ מִ מִּשְׁתֵּ֣ה הַ יַּ֔יִן אֶל גִּנַּ֖ת הַ בִּיתָ֑ן
traditions.LXX: ὁ δὲ βασιλεὺς ἐξανέστη ἀπὸ τοῦ συμποσίου εἰς τὸν κῆπον ·
traditions.VUL: Rex autem irátus surréxit , et de loco convívii intrávit in hortum arbóribus cónsitum .
traditions.KJV: And the king arising from the banquet of wine in his wrath [ went ] into the palace garden :

7.english_reference: and Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen

traditions.WLC: וְ הָמָ֣ן עָמַ֗ד לְ בַקֵּ֤שׁ עַל נַפְשׁ וֹ֙ מֵֽ אֶסְתֵּ֣ר הַ מַּלְכָּ֔ה
traditions.LXX: ὁ δὲ Ἁμὰν παρῃτεῖτο τὴν βασιλίσσαν ,
traditions.VUL: Aman quoque surréxit ut rogáret Esther regínam pro ánima sua ,
traditions.KJV: and Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen ;

7.english_reference: for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י רָאָ֔ה כִּֽי כָלְתָ֥ה אֵלָ֛י ו הָ רָעָ֖ה מֵ אֵ֥ת הַ מֶּֽלֶךְ
traditions.LXX: ἑώρα γὰρ ἑαυτὸν ἐν κακοῖς ὄντα .
traditions.VUL: intelléxit enim a rege sibi parátum malum .
traditions.KJV: for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king .

8.english_reference: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ מֶּ֡לֶךְ שָׁב֩ מִ גִּנַּ֨ת הַ בִּיתָ֜ן אֶל בֵּ֣ית מִשְׁתֵּ֣ה הַ יַּ֗יִן
traditions.LXX: ἐπέστρεψεν δὲ ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐκ τοῦ κήπου ,
traditions.VUL: Qui cum revérsus esset de horto nemóribus cónsito , et intrásset convívii locum ,
traditions.KJV: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine ;

8.english_reference: and Haman was fallen upon the bed whereon Esther [ was ]

traditions.WLC: וְ הָמָן֙ נֹפֵ֔ל עַל הַ מִּטָּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶסְתֵּ֣ר עָלֶ֔י הָ
traditions.LXX: Ἁμὰν δὲ ἐπιπεπτώκει ἐπὶ τὴν κλίνην ἀξιῶν τὴν βασιλίσσαν ·
traditions.VUL: réperit Aman super léctulum corruísse , in quo iacébat Esther ,
traditions.KJV: and Haman was fallen upon the bed whereon Esther [ was ] .

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ βασιλεύς
traditions.VUL: et ait :
traditions.KJV: Then said the king ,

8.english_reference: Will he force the queen also before me in the house ?

traditions.WLC: הֲ֠ גַם לִ כְבּ֧וֹשׁ אֶת הַ מַּלְכָּ֛ה עִמִּ֖ י בַּ בָּ֑יִת
traditions.LXX: Ὥστε καὶ τὴν γυναῖκα βιάζῃ ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ μου ;
traditions.VUL: Etiam regínam vult opprímere , me præsénte , in domo mea .
traditions.KJV: Will he force the queen also before me in the house ?

8.english_reference: As the word went out of the king ’s mouth

traditions.WLC: הַ דָּבָ֗ר יָצָא֙ מִ פִּ֣י הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ
traditions.VUL: Necdum verbum de ore regis exíerat ,
traditions.KJV: As the word went out of the king ’s mouth ,

traditions.WLC: וּ פְנֵ֥י הָמָ֖ן חָפֽוּ
traditions.LXX: Ἁμὰν δὲ ἀκούσας διετράπη τῷ προσώπῳ .
traditions.VUL: et statim operuérunt fáciem eius .
traditions.KJV: they covered Haman ’s face .

10.english_reference: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתְלוּ֙ אֶת הָמָ֔ן עַל הָ עֵ֖ץ אֲשֶׁר הֵכִ֣ין לְ מָרְדֳּכָ֑י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκρεμάσθη Ἁμὰν ἐπὶ τοῦ ξύλου ὃ ἡτοιμάσθη Μαρδοχαίῳ .
traditions.VUL: Suspénsus est ítaque Aman in patíbulo , quod paráverat Mardochǽo :
traditions.KJV: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai .

10.english_reference: Then was the king ’s wrath pacified

traditions.WLC: וַ חֲמַ֥ת הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ שָׁכָֽכָה
traditions.LXX: καὶ τότε ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐκόπασεν τοῦ θυμοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et regis ira quiévit .
traditions.KJV: Then was the king ’s wrath pacified .
